name: Heated
description: The first heat level, from a Blaze Burner with fuel.

pages.title: Heated
pages.text:
**Heated** is the heat level of a Blaze Burner that has fuel. Recipes marked heated, such as brass, only run in a basin with a heated burner under it.\
\
A superheated burner counts as heated too. The burner cools down when its fuel runs out.
